export function allOf(rules){return value=>{let i=0;while(i<rules.length){const result=Reflect.apply(rules[i++],undefined,[value]);if(result.ok===false)return{ok:false,errors:Array.from(result.errors)};}return{ok:true,errors:[]};};}
export function anyOf(rules){return value=>{let i=0,collected=[];while(i<rules.length){const result=Reflect.apply(rules[i++],undefined,[value]);if(result.ok===true)return{ok:true,errors:[]};collected=collected.concat(result.errors);}return{ok:false,errors:collected};};}
